Konkrs

Conker tournaments, organised.

Coming Soon

Konkrs is the all-in-one platform for running conker tournaments in your local park or community event. Create tournaments, manage participants, generate brackets, assign referees, and record match results — while players register and follow live standings from the web or their phone.

  • BracketsAuto-generated and always up to date
  • RefereesAssign officials to every match
  • Live standingsPlayers follow along in real time
  • Any deviceWeb and mobile, wherever the conkers fall

Be first to know when Konkrs launches. No spam, ever.
